item.description: In at least six statehouses this year, lawmakers are revisiting a long-running debate over whether guns should be allowed on college campuses. item.title: Abortion bans led to higher preterm birth rates among Black women, study finds
item.description: Black women living in states with abortion bans were more likely to have preterm babies, compared with what would be expected in the absence of those bans, according to a study published in this month’s issue of the American Journal of Public Health. item.title: The pay gap between women and men widened last year, analysis finds
item.description: The earnings gap between men and women slightly widened last year, according to a new analysis published Thursday. The left-leaning Economic Policy Institute calculated women last year earned 18.6% less than men per hour on average. That’s up slightly from 2024, when the wage gap narrowed slightly to 18%. item.description: Since their peak less than three years ago, opioid overdose deaths dropped nearly by half as of October, according to a Stateline analysis.
